label: scope4-cap-reopened-hardening-blocks
description: Authored Scope 4 convergence-precedence case: the >=3-round reopen convergence block keeps precedence over the cap conversion, so a re-opened hardening canonical terminal-blocks at the cap rather than converting. roundLimit is 5 (default threshold 3). Round 3 banks a first-occurrence hardening finding (C3) while a co-occurring plan-correctness finding (Cc) forces the round. Rounds 4 and 5 re-raise C3 (fixed between rounds). By round 5 (== the cap) C3 has appeared as a blocking finding in three distinct rounds (3, 4, 5), so getReopenedCanonical fires and the disposition is block_for_operator with the review-stuck reopened reason; C3 is NOT converted to debt (its latest finding is open).
